notes: Labels only accept the same characters as targets ([\w0-9_ -]), so `[[Page|it's]]` or a label with punctuation is left as literal text. This is documented in docs/extensions/wikilinks.md and the issue's examples don't need more. A later change could allow a wider set of characters in labels.
Inside a `tables` row, `[[P|l]]` is split at the pipe into two cells. That is how table parsing already works (block level runs before inline), not a regression, but the docs could mention it.
`[[ | x]]` renders as an empty paragraph, the same as the existing blank-target behaviour for `[[ ]]`.
The test names (test_ac_fr_001_1_...) come from the pipeline's requirement IDs and don't say what each test checks, but this is only cosmetic.
Changelog entry is present under Unreleased > Added. No ARCHITECTURE.md constraints are touched: the change stays inside the extension and the processor priority is unchanged.
summary: The PR does what the issue asks. `[[Target|Label]]` links to the same URL as `[[Target]]` and shows the label. Whitespace around the pipe is ignored. The base_url, end_url, html_class, build_url and meta settings behave as before, and links without a pipe are unchanged. I checked each of these by running code, including edge cases the PR's tests don't cover. The new tests fail when the fix is reverted, the full suite passes and flake8 is clean. The changelog and docs are updated.
